provenance: Field names from chat.html's handler, which reads both spellings (rate_limit_info / rateLimitInfo) after originalModel-vs-original_model bit the refusal fallback. client-parity records this path as unforceable against a real CLI — no way to make a real limit happen — so this fixture is the only evidence available and asserts the three behaviours the handler owes: silence on allowed, speech on rejected, and no repetition.

steps.note: rejected speaks, with the label for the type
the same limit again is not restated
an unknown shape yields no status and stays silent
